note: Today's batch for the Founder's OK (decisions/0179 rule 1; Piece 2, P2-5), written by the session manager once a day (UTC). One line per release waiting: its release (the zip), what it does, why, its decision, the checks it passed on staging, its way back, and the Work queue tickets it closes. Then run python3 tools/page-audit/gauges.py and commit: the site shows it at the top of the Work queue (System Control Board → Development) only on its own date, with the Tier 3 decisions waiting first, and Approve the batch for the Founder. An empty date (as here) shows "No batch from the session manager today". Messages for the Founder go in "messages" ([{id, at, subject, body}], plain text with links): the site emails each id once, to the Founder only, through its own email (FounderMail). Never reuse an id.
